query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ur.cost_usd), 0) AS "total_spend_usd!", COALESCE(SUM(ur.input_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "total_input_tokens!", COALESCE(SUM(ur.output_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "total_output_tokens!", COUNT(DISTINCT ur.task_id) AS "task_count!" FROM usage_records ur WHERE ur.workspace_id = $1 AND ur.created_at >= $2 AND ur.created_at < $3
